description: This file defines interfaces, functions, and constants related to edge overview nodes and entity node representations within the Thingsboard UI module, including icon and label generation based on entity types.

methods.name: edgeGroupsNodeText
methods.description: Generates the combined icon and label text for edge group nodes based on entity type.

methods.name: entityNodeText
methods.description: Creates a label with icon for a specific entity, using its name and type.

methods.name: materialIconByEntityType
methods.description: Returns an HTML string with a material icon corresponding to the given entity type.

methods.name: textForEdgeGroupsType
methods.description: Provides a translated label for edge group types based on entity type.
